chatFlows.label: July variance
chatFlows.response:
July opex landed at **$21.34M vs $19.90M budget — $1.44M (7.2%) over**, the biggest miss this fiscal year.

{{chart:bars}}

- **Engineering +$862K** — AWS reserved-instance commit true-up hit in one month instead of amortizing across Q3.
- **IT +$388K** — Salesforce renewal posted in July; last year it landed in August, so this is timing, not overspend.
- **Marketing +$214K** — Q3 sales kickoff in Austin, approved out-of-cycle.
- Product (-$58K) and Customer Success (-$84K) came in under.

Net of the Salesforce timing shift, the structural overrun is roughly **$1.05M**, nearly all cloud.

> Recommended: confirm the Q4 AWS run-rate with James Whitfield at your 10:30 before this goes in the QBR pre-read.
